lines: To: All applicants in response to the above noted RFP

The Housing Authority of the City and County of San Francisco is pleased to announce that, as a result of our evaluation of applications received in response to the above noted RFP, the Authority has awarded nine (9) new properties to our PBV portfolio to provide housing for the low-income residents of San Francisco. The Authority was able to award 125 project-based vouchers to be distributed amongst the properties listed below.
